decision: Drop the 24 trips whose actual_arrival does not parse (08:60 minute) and fix the one misconfigured +00:00 device by converting to canonical +05:30 local arrival.
Apply REC-114: measure R-14 against 53 min and R-27 against 45 min revised runtime instead of the export's scheduled_runtime_min.
Define a trip as late only when lateness > 5 minutes, and rank routes by median (not mean) lateness, with pct trips >5 min as the reliability cross-check.
quote: A trip is 'late' when lateness_min > 5 minutes

decision: Do not count R-35 as a worst route: its Wednesday waterlogging day adds ~50 min to every trip but its median is 2 min, so it is tail risk, not systemic lateness.
Worst three are R-33, R-27, R-26, chosen over R-37 because R-26 has a higher share of trips >5 min late (42.3% vs 40.0%) on equal median 4 min.

Treat the 4xx-series runtime correction as route-level for R-14/R-27 per REC-114 even though the export's vehicle_series is stored as two digits; R-14 swings from +7.62 min mean to -0.17 min and comes off the worst list.
